title: A Claude background launcher end whose outstanding entry was evicted, or that came from a replaced runtime, attaches nothing and records no reason
outcome: When Claude reports the end of a background task whose key has an uncarried launcher launch row, but the session holds no outstanding entry for it (evicted at the outstanding-work limit, or the frame is from a replaced runtime), the row records a typed reason why nothing was attached.
acceptance: A Claude background launcher end whose outstanding entry was evicted, or that came from a replaced runtime, attaches nothing and records no reason is done
